causal_finding.code: await state.hook?.({ stage, count: ++state.counts[stage], key, args, value })
causal_finding.cause: Optional chaining does not evaluate arguments when hook is undefined, so counters stay zero despite observed calls and correct numeric output.
causal_finding.fix: Increment count before invoking optional hook; preserve all assertions, values, cases, and budgets.
causal_finding.qualification: No acceptance of entire unit candidate; retain observed32 passes and3 failures.
